scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n API,WEB -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others -n API,WEB "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run preview --prefix frontend"
